description:
Outcome: First-version search/lend/return journey demonstrably preserves records on restart, from owner requirements.
Scope: Integrated HTTP/restart/uncertain-outcome/operation-id retry tests; active-label persistence and returned-label erasure; correct README claims, startup/testing/local-use/storage location, backup/restore, nondestructive recovery and privacy instructions; explicitly record overdue deferral. Excludes: overdue implementation, testing or demonstration; cloud and new backup services.
Acceptance: Catalogue, ids, active loans, due dates and recorded returns survive restart. Corrupt bytes remain untouched; failed/uncertain saves never imply false success or rollback; operation retries converge after restart/recovery. Exercise documented backup/restore. Explain that old backups may retain pupil labels and require local access restrictions and manual deletion/rotation; do not claim automatic erasure of external copies.
Behaviour: Actionable nondestructive recovery; fictional pupil labels, isolated temp-directory fixtures and cleanup limited to test-owned data.
Verification: npm test during implementation plus manual browser, restart and backup/restore exercise limited to first-version journey. Prerequisites: A2 catalogue UI, B2 lending/return controls. Assumptions: single local process and documented supported filesystem durability limits.
Setup alias: D1.
title: First-version restart and recovery evidence
